mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM system_role_menu rm LEFT JOIN system_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN system_role r ON rm.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN system_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and r.status = 0 and rm.delete_flag = 0 and m.delete_flag = 0 and m.status = 0 and m.permission is not null and m.permission != ''

select distinct sm.* from system_user_role sur inner join system_role_menu srm on srm.role_id = sur.role_id inner join system_menu sm on sm.id = srm.menu_id where sur.delete_flag = 0 and srm.delete_flag = 0 and sm.delete_flag = 0 and sm.status = 0 and sur.user_id = #{userId} order by sm.sort, sm.create_time
select menu_id from system_role_menu where role_id = #{roleId} and delete_flag = 0
SELECT m.* FROM system_menu m WHERE m.delete_flag = 0 order by m.sort, m.create_time
